name: No hardware acceleration · Force software emulation (example)
author: ApkStart
description: When Windows Hypervisor Platform is disabled and kernel driver installation is restricted, hardware-accelerated emulator launches fail immediately. This patch forces software emulation (-accel off) from the start to skip failed attempts and switches rendering to software to avoid GL initialization errors.

notes: Software emulation is 5-10x slower than hardware acceleration; enable Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features if possible
